label: Compile & Run C (Windows)
command: $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/build/$ZED_RELATIVE_DIR" | Out-Null; gcc -std=c11 -DDEBUG -O2 "$ZED_FILE" -o "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/build/$ZED_RELATIVE_DIR/$ZED_STEM.exe"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/build/$ZED_RELATIVE_DIR/$ZED_STEM.exe" }; exit $LASTEXITCODE

label: Compile & Run C++ (Windows)
command: $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/build/$ZED_RELATIVE_DIR" | Out-Null; g++ -std=c++17 -DDEBUG -O2 "$ZED_FILE" -o "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/build/$ZED_RELATIVE_DIR/$ZED_STEM.exe"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/build/$ZED_RELATIVE_DIR/$ZED_STEM.exe" }; exit $LASTEXITCODE
